consistency_internal.explantion: Both responses suffer from false consensus, attribution failures, and blurred viewpoints, but Response a demonstrates a comparatively clearer segmentation of mechanisms (income loss, savings depletion, structural shifts, personal barriers) even though it still merges macro‑economic and micro‑level factors.
